title: Refund amount is never validated against captured amount
explanation: refund() accepts any amount and returns it as refunded without checking it against order.captured. A caller can refund more than was captured, including negative or non-finite values, which can lead to over-refunding customers and inconsistent ledger state. The function also performs no bounds checks at all, so the bug is not limited to a single edge case.
failureScenario: An order with captured = 50 is refunded with amount = 500. The function returns { refunded: 500 } and the caller pays out 500 against 50 captured. Passing a negative amount would similarly produce a negative refund.

fix.summary: Validate amount is finite, positive, and not greater than order.captured before returning the refund.
